rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock contracts not secured by pre-FEED gate
rules.recommended_action: Notify feedstock manager to finalise contracts

rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock moisture > 20% consistently
rules.recommended_action: Engage feedstock pretreatment vendor to reduce moisture below 15%

rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock ash content > 5% consistently
rules.recommended_action: Audit feedstock source and implement ash reduction preprocessing

rules.trigger_condition: Feedstock alkali/chlorine/sulfur exceeding design
rules.recommended_action: Halt procurement from non-compliant sources; update feedstock specification and retest

rules.trigger_condition: Gasifier vendor delay > 30 days
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to project director; explore liquidated damages or alternative vendor

rules.trigger_condition: Gasifier cold gas efficiency below 70%
rules.recommended_action: Commission performance test and engage gasifier OEM for troubleshooting

rules.trigger_condition: Syngas cleanup package not procured by EPC start
rules.recommended_action: Initiate emergency procurement; request expedited bidding from prequalified vendors

rules.trigger_condition: Syngas tar > 50 mg/Nm3 after cleanup
rules.recommended_action: Investigate scrubber and reformer performance; increase temperature if needed

rules.trigger_condition: Sulfur breakthrough > 10 ppbv in guard bed outlet
rules.recommended_action: Replace guard bed sorbent immediately; check upstream desulfurisation unit

rules.trigger_condition: Chlorine breakthrough > 10 ppbv
rules.recommended_action: Replace chlorine guard material; verify upstream chloride removal efficiency

rules.trigger_condition: H2/CO ratio unresolved before FEED close
rules.recommended_action: Conduct WGS reactor sizing review and finalise H2 addition strategy

rules.trigger_condition: H2/CO ratio outside 1.8-2.2 for cobalt FT
rules.recommended_action: Adjust WGS bypass or H2 injection rate; recalculate syngas composition target

rules.trigger_condition: FT catalyst order not placed 12 months before loading
rules.recommended_action: Release purchase order with premium expedite; check catalyst shelf-life constraints

rules.trigger_condition: FT reactor package delayed > 30 days
rules.recommended_action: Activate recovery schedule; review critical path and re-sequence downstream activities

rules.trigger_condition: FT catalyst performance below 60% conversion
rules.recommended_action: Initiate catalyst root-cause analysis; prepare catalyst change-out plan

rules.trigger_condition: Hydrocracker/isomerization vendor selection delayed
rules.recommended_action: Conduct accelerated bid evaluation; reduce shortlist to two vendors

rules.trigger_condition: Hydrocracker catalyst not ordered by EPC start
rules.recommended_action: Place catalyst order with lead-time buffer; confirm regeneration cycle compatibility

rules.trigger_condition: Jet fractionation column spec not complete
rules.recommended_action: Complete process design basis and submit column datasheet to vendor

rules.trigger_condition: ASTM D7566 qualification plan not started by FEED
rules.recommended_action: Engage ASTM testing lab and draft qualification test protocol

rules.trigger_condition: ASTM fuel test schedule not defined before commissioning
rules.recommended_action: Define fuel sampling and testing schedule; reserve laboratory capacity

rules.trigger_condition: Sustainability certification scheme not selected by Phase 2
rules.recommended_action: Evaluate ISCC, RSB, and CORSIA requirements; select scheme by Phase 2 gate

rules.trigger_condition: ISCC/RSB/CORSIA chain-of-custody evidence gaps
rules.recommended_action: Audit mass balance records; remediate documentation gaps with feedstock suppliers

rules.trigger_condition: Carbon intensity estimate not completed before FEED
rules.recommended_action: Commission CI modelling from sustainability consultant before FEED close

rules.trigger_condition: HAZOP recommendations not closed before construction
rules.recommended_action: Assign owners and deadlines; escalate overdue actions to project steering committee

rules.trigger_condition: HAZOP recommendations overdue > 60 days
rules.recommended_action: Issue non-compliance notice to action owner; escalate to HSE director

rules.trigger_condition: EIA application not submitted by Phase 3 gate
rules.recommended_action: Mobilise environmental consultant for expedited submission; engage regulator pre-submission

rules.trigger_condition: Air emissions permit not submitted
rules.recommended_action: Complete emissions modelling and permit application; engage regulatory liaison

rules.trigger_condition: Commissioning readiness below 70% at 60 days to start-up
rules.recommended_action: Increase commissioning workforce; compress pre-commissioning checklist timeline

rules.trigger_condition: Commissioning punch list exceeds 50 items 30 days to start-up
rules.recommended_action: Prioritise safety-critical and quality-critical items; mobilise additional contractor resources

rules.trigger_condition: Product quality test plan not established
rules.recommended_action: Draft product quality plan covering all ASTM D7566 Annex requirements

rules.trigger_condition: SAF freeze point fails specification
rules.recommended_action: Adjust hydrocracker severity or isomerisation conditions; re-test batch

rules.trigger_condition: SAF flash point fails specification
rules.recommended_action: Review fractionation cut points; adjust distillation column temperature profile

rules.trigger_condition: SAF density outside 730-770 kg/m3
rules.recommended_action: Adjust blending ratio or hydrocracker conversion rate to meet density target

rules.trigger_condition: SAF thermal stability (JFTOT) fails at 325°C
rules.recommended_action: Investigate trace contaminants; check hydrotreating severity and adsorbent beds

rules.trigger_condition: Offtake agreement not signed before commissioning
rules.recommended_action: Finalise offtake negotiations; engage legal team to close commercial terms

rules.trigger_condition: Blending logistics not confirmed before first production
rules.recommended_action: Confirm truck/rail/pipeline logistics provider; execute blending services agreement

rules.trigger_condition: Airport fuel terminal interface not established
rules.recommended_action: Engage airport fuel consortium; finalise terminal connection and custody transfer protocol

rules.trigger_condition: Operator training not completed
rules.recommended_action: Schedule simulator and field training sessions; verify competency assessments passed

rules.trigger_condition: Emergency response drill not conducted
rules.recommended_action: Schedule tabletop and full-scale emergency drill before start-up

rules.trigger_condition: H2 supply not secured before commissioning
rules.recommended_action: Finalise H2 supply agreement; confirm delivery schedule and backup supply provision
